policy: Any unresolved releaseBlocking source defect prevents official full-coverage language pack publication.

items.source: Playlist storage is waiting for the Room v28 integration. Existing Room v27 search and music-pool actions remain available; playlist changes are not saved yet.
items.finding: Old English says Room v28 integration is still pending but Room v28 is already configured; UI displays this when repository is null.
items.proposedSource: Playlist storage is unavailable right now. You can still browse your music library, but playlist changes cannot be saved until storage becomes available.
items.suggestedZhTW: 目前無法使用播放清單儲存功能。仍可瀏覽音樂庫，但在儲存功能恢復前無法保存播放清單變更。
items.suggestedJa: 現在、プレイリストを保存できません。音楽ライブラリは引き続き閲覧できますが、保存機能が利用可能になるまで変更内容は保存されません。
items.disposition: DO_NOT_TRANSLATE_OUTDATED_SOURCE_FOR_RELEASE; fix canonical English and re-review each locale
